correctness.rationale: Independently checked the weights (1,9,4,3,5) preserve sum x_i²x_{i+1}, cyclic conjugation is exponent five, and tangent differences at the five order-eleven fixed coordinate points are unit multiples of (2,3,4). Eleven order-five subgroups each fix four nonoverlapping nonvertex points, giving four G-orbits. Explicit residue-age lists are [9,18,16,14,23,10,19,17,15,24]/11 and [6,7,8,9]/5. Smoothness follows by nonzero-coordinate gradient product contradiction. The quotient action is free in codimension one, adjunction gives 24/55, H^3(X) ten-dimensional cyclotomic rational C11 module via fixed point Lefschetz trace -1, so no odd invariant cohomology. The finite quotient cohomology theorem and Armstrong stabilizer-normal-closure fundamental-group formula prove the stated topology. No finite modular check purports to certify these topological theorems.
